info.name: Princess Toadstool’s Purple Kingdom
info.description: Transform your Google homepage into a whimsical, pastel-purple Mushroom Kingdom! This theme swaps out harsh golds and reds for soft lavender, deep violet, and dreamy pink accents. Featuring retro pixelated clouds, star icons styled in gentle soft pinks, and a clean, gamer-chic aesthetic that keeps your browsing space cute, calm, and distraction-free.
